get.description: Fleet-wide aggregate: one row per package name. Default landing view.
All distinct versions of one named package, with per-version minion counts.

post.description:
Row-level package search. Used by level 3 (minions with one specific
name+version) and as a power-user query endpoint (version comparison,
multi-field filter).

get.description:
List the names of execution functions the salt master knows about.

Requires authentication (any logged-in user). Cached for 1 hour to
avoid hammering salt-api on every page render.

post.description: Throwaway client. Validates creds without persisting.

Test the credentials currently persisted in the DB. Used by the
settings page when the operator hasn't re-typed the password — we
can't roundtrip it through the form (security), but we can still
validate it server-side.

PackageAggregate.title: PackageAggregate
PackageAggregate.description: One row in the fleet-wide package list.

PackageQueryHit.title: PackageQueryHit
PackageQueryHit.description: One row in the response to a package query.

PackageQueryIn.title: PackageQueryIn
PackageQueryIn.description:
Filter for ``GET /api/inventory/packages``.

At least one of ``name`` or ``minion_id`` MUST be supplied — we don't
want to accidentally let the UI fetch the entire fleet's package list
in one request. (A future "browse all" endpoint can lift this rule.)

PackageQueryOut.title: PackageQueryOut
PackageQueryOut.description:
Wrapper that lets us tack pagination metadata on later without breaking
the wire format.

RefreshIn.title: RefreshIn
RefreshIn.description:
Body for ``POST /api/inventory/refresh``.

``target='*'`` + ``target_type='glob'`` means "every connected minion".
Pin the target down if you want to refresh just one host.

SaltSettingsIn.title: SaltSettingsIn
SaltSettingsIn.description:
PUT body for the salt section. All fields optional — only the
ones present are applied. At least one must be present.

SaltSettingsOut.title: SaltSettingsOut
SaltSettingsOut.description:
Salt API connection settings. Password is never returned — only
a boolean ``password_set`` so the UI can render "(set)" without
exposing the value.

TestSaltConnectionIn.title: TestSaltConnectionIn
TestSaltConnectionIn.description: POST body for the test-connection endpoint. All fields required.

TimelineBar.title: TimelineBar
TimelineBar.description: One job invocation on the timeline.

TimelineGroup.title: TimelineGroup
TimelineGroup.description:
A row on the timeline. ``key`` identifies the group (function name
or username), ``label`` is what the UI displays.

VersionAggregate.title: VersionAggregate
VersionAggregate.description: One row in the per-package version list.
